summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the final ratio and share count for its interim scrip dividend totaling €400 million. The ratio is one new share per 103.5826 existing shares, based on a VWAP of €57.7784. Cash or stock election was offered; 75.55% of holders elected shares. The dividend is settled from treasury shares, so total shares outstanding remain unchanged. Cash settlements use BFIX EUR/USD rate of 1.1651. This is a mandatory convertible dividend (scrip dividend), not a tender or buyback. Watch for future dividend policy or share cancellation signals.
